note: each CVE dated by the first rule that applies: no NVD record, published after the as of time, the current record when it was fetched at or before the as of time, the newest change history status event at or before it, else the current status (the NVD change history fetched through 2024-07-22T22:15:02Z); a finding counts once, under the most advanced status among its CVEs

rules.no_nvd_record: the CVE is not in bronze nvd_cves
rules.published_after: the NVD published the CVE after the as of time
rules.current_record: the NVD record bronze holds was fetched at or before the as of time
rules.change_history: the newest status event at or before the as of time in the NVD change history
rules.current_status_fallback: no status event at or before the as of time in the history fetched so far; the current status stands in for it
